title: results.json: a ticket's results, written only by tooling
description: Written by yarn contract:init (every criterion FAIL), contract:run, contract:record, contract:add, contract:qa, contract:built, review:run and cost --record. check-specs validates every results.json against this file (A9, A13.2).

id.description: The ticket's work-id, as in WEB-41 or OB2-3; equals the contract's id and the folder's prefix.

criteria_sha256.description: Hash of the contract's criteria set, frozen at init; only contract:add changes it.

criteria.description: One entry per contract criterion, keyed by its id.

built_at.description: When yarn contract:built said the code is in (audit R9). The ticket reads built until a criterion is recorded at or after it.

cost.description: What the ticket's threads cost, written by yarn cost <id> --record (audit R4): one API call per message id; tokens weighted input 1, cache write 1.25, cache read 0.1, output 5 [estimate of cost, not the meter]; calls attributed to the ticket most recently named in a work command in their thread [estimate]; each classified by its first tool. Never any transcript text.

context_last_call.description: Input, cache read and cache write of the ticket's last main-thread call; null when every call was a subagent's.

headless_runs.description: review:run runs on record in results.json that carry cost fields: the last run per review criterion.

run.description: The last run that set this status; null until one has.

runs.description: For a review: completed review:run runs that gave a verdict. The cap reads it: a second run only after a FAIL, a third only with --operator (WEB-12).

refused.description: Every review:run attempt a guard stopped before the reviewer ran, oldest first: when and why. A completed run never clears them.

run.description: A9's run record, plus HEAD (A13.2 B2) and, for a review, what it reviewed (B1) and what it cost.

tests.description: Tests the runner reported for a test criterion; zero fails the criterion.

criteria_sha256.description: For a review: the criteria set it judged (the results' criteria_sha256 at the time). A criterion added later makes the PASS stale; nothing else does (WEB-12).

deferred.description: true when a manual criterion only a person can check was handed to the operator (contract:record --verdict deferred). It never holds the ticket; _status.md lists it under Operator checks.

tokens_input.description: A review's cost, from the headless result's usage: uncached input tokens.

tokens_cache_read.description: Input tokens read from the prompt cache.

tokens_cache_write.description: Input tokens written to the prompt cache.

seconds.description: Wall-clock seconds of the reviewer process, measured by review:run.
